capability: closed-world factual retrieval with paraphrase routing and explicit abstention

workload.design: independently authored and reviewed before execution; freeze bytes and SHA-256; no tuning on final test

requirements: same fixed task identifiers and reference answers for every system
evaluate complete question-to-answer pipeline not canonical key lookup alone
include storage and conversion cost; report amortization and break-even
measure whole-system peak RAM consistently; energy with documented meter boundary
record warm/cold runs and raw outputs
all model revisions, binary hashes, quantization and flags recorded
operator review of dataset independence and evidence provenance

evidence.limitations: Six factual fixtures only; no independent gate workload, quantized baseline or target-hardware energy evidence.
